column3: char:swordsman 技の副題(キャラ選択の名前の下の一行)
column4: One Who Never Stops

column3: char:swordsman 説明(キャラ選択の紹介文。改行の数は元の文と同じに)
column4:
A lone swordsman on his own path.
His three-hit combo advances forward.
He launches foes with an upward slash
and strikes down with a diving slash.

column3: char:dual_blade 技の副題(キャラ選択の名前の下の一行)
column4: Swift Blades, Endless Dance

column3: char:dual_blade 型ラベル(キャラ選択のバッジ・カードの小さな字。英語の大文字)
column4: SWIFT COMBO

column3: char:dual_blade 説明(キャラ選択の紹介文。改行の数は元の文と同じに)
column4:
She runs fast and strikes even faster.
Her five-hit combo works on the ground
and in midair. Each hit is light,
but her speed makes up for it.

column3: char:noble_lady 技の副題(キャラ選択の名前の下の一行)
column4: A Hero Yet to Awaken

column3: char:noble_lady 説明(キャラ選択の紹介文。改行の数は元の文と同じに)
column4:
Her greatsword hits hard. Beyond 20 km,
her power and reach keep growing.
Enemy hits cannot interrupt
her attacks.

column3: char:gunslinger 説明(キャラ選択の紹介文。改行の数は元の文と同じに)
column4: She fires forward, back, or diagonally\nup or down. Downshots slow her fall.\nEach narrow bullet hits only one foe.

column3: char:dragon_lancer 技の副題(キャラ選択の名前の下の一行)
column4: Pierce Through, Never Yield

column3: char:dragon_lancer 型ラベル(キャラ選択のバッジ・カードの小さな字。英語の大文字)
column4: PIERCER

column3: char:dragon_lancer 説明(キャラ選択の紹介文。改行の数は元の文と同じに)
column4:
His long spear pierces lined-up foes
with heavy damage and knockback.
But enemies too close to him
are hard to hit.

column3: char:archer 説明(キャラ選択の紹介文。改行の数は元の文と同じに)
column4:
Waiting after any shot strengthens
his next forward arrow. At full charge,
it pierces foes. Rapid fire is weak;
taking damage resets the charge.

column3: char:mage 説明(キャラ選択の紹介文。改行の数は元の文と同じに)
column4:
She floats above the ground and gaps.
Changing height casts a spell.
Her HP is low, and enemy hits
knock her back farther.

column3: char:fighter 技の副題(キャラ選択の名前の下の一行)
column4: A Fist That Strikes Back

column3: char:fighter 説明(キャラ選択の紹介文。改行の数は元の文と同じに)
column4:
His short-range combo ends in a
powerful fourth hit. A timed back
stance counters enemy attacks safely,
but cannot stop falls or hazards.

column3: char:ninja 技の副題(キャラ選択の名前の下の一行)
column4: Vanish, Slash, Vanish Again

column3: char:ninja 説明(キャラ選択の紹介文。改行の数は元の文と同じに)
column4:
She dashes through foes with a slash.
Her dash grants brief invulnerability,
but her low maximum HP leaves
little room for mistakes.

column3: char:miko 説明(キャラ選択の紹介文。改行の数は元の文と同じに)
column4:
Her talismans explode after a delay;
a second triggers a bigger blast.
Her barrier slows regular foes,
and her shikigami attacks behind.

column3: char:vampire 技の副題(キャラ選択の名前の下の一行)
column4: Keep Hitting, Grow Stronger

column3: char:vampire 説明(キャラ選択の紹介文。改行の数は元の文と同じに)
column4:
Hits fill his blood gauge, boosting
power and speed. At full gauge, he gets
a five-second boost and can heal.
It drains when he stops hitting
or is hit on the ground.

column3: char:dragonkin 技の副題(キャラ選択の名前の下の一行)
column4: Claws, Tail, Wings, Flame

column3: char:dragonkin 説明(キャラ選択の紹介文。改行の数は元の文と同じに)
column4:
She sweeps foes with claws, tail,
and flame. She can jump high and glide.
Her large body is easy to hit, but she
has high HP and resists knockback.

column3: char:luka 技の副題(キャラ選択の名前の下の一行)
column4: Cat Punches, Pounces, Big Jumps

column3: char:luka 説明(キャラ選択の紹介文。改行の数は元の文と同じに)
column4:
A brave little tabby with quick paws
and fearless pounces. His small body
slips past danger, and he jumps high.
No weapons or armor needed.

column3: char:pentatuttulu 技の副題(キャラ選択の名前の下の一行)
column4: Stretch, Bounce, Boing!

column3: char:pentatuttulu 説明(キャラ選択の紹介文。改行の数は元の文と同じに)
column4:
Its arms and legs stretch far.
Stomping a foe in midair makes it bounce
up once per jump. No one knows
where this fluffy visitor came from.
